## About
My name is Alex Meehleib, and working on cars is my passion. When I opened my own shop, I decided AZ would be my home, and I have been serving this community as best I can ever since.
I do a little of everything, from basic oil changes and brakes up to transmissions. No job is too small or too big, and I want it done right before your car leaves the shop.
Fixing cars is good work, but the best part is the friendships made with customers along the way. If something is wrong with your vehicle, reach out and I will help however I can.

## Services
- Brakes: Brake work for everyday drivers, one of the basics we handle all the time.
- Oil changes: Routine oil changes to keep your engine running the way it should.
- Transmission work: From transmission repair to replacement, the bigger jobs are welcome too.
- Radiator service and repair: Cooling system service and repair to help keep your engine from overheating.
- Shock and strut replacement: Replacing worn shocks and struts so your car rides and handles right.
- Belts and hoses: Checking and replacing belts and hoses before they leave you stranded.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on foreign cars?
A: Yes. We work on both foreign and domestic vehicles.

Q: What if the repair I need isn't listed?
A: Not to worry. Contact us and tell us what is going on, and we will take care of it.

Q: What's the quickest way to reach you?
A: You can call, but for a quicker response, message us on Facebook.
